import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv', index_col=False)

# Convert adult_male to boolean
df['adult_male'] = df['adult_male'].map({True: 'Yes', False: 'No'})

# Create a count plot of survived by sex
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='sex', hue='survived', data=df)
plt.title('Survival Rate by Sex')
plt.xlabel('Sex')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Survived')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
